title: Stocks Fall as Chip Rout Overshadows Drop in Oil: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street kicked off the week on a cautious note, with a selloff in chipmakers outweighing an oil drop as traders parsed Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s plan to isolate Iran from the global economy.

title: Tech Leads US Stocks Lower as Nvidia Earnings, Jackson Hole Loom
summary: Technology names led a decline in US stocks on Monday as investors geared up for a busy week of economic data and earnings from Nvidia Corp.

title: Nvidia Slides Ahead of Earnings as Tech Stocks Retreat | Closing Bell
summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Emily Graffeo, Norah Mulinda and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
summary: Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu puts Isabelle Lee, Athanasios Psarofagis, and Eric Balchunas to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Who Is Buying America’s Debt These Days?
summary: With the US now $40 trillion in the red, the US Treasury’s sudden move to rein in bond yields has cast a spotlight on who is, and isn’t, purchasing American debt these days. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: First Brands Bankruptcy-Payout Plan Rejected by Federal Judge
summary: A federal judge rejected the bankruptcy-payout plan of defunct auto-parts maker First Brands, concluding the proposal to raise money by suing a long list of insiders and business partners was not realistic.

title: Wellington Launches Funds with Blackstone, Vanguard
summary: Nick Samouilhan, portfolio manager at Wellington Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." Blackstone teamed up with Wellington Management and Vanguard Group to create two new funds that will give individual investors access to private assets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Asia Buyers Snap Up American Crude, Add Stress to Tight Market
summary: Asian refiners are on course to nearly double their purchases of US crude for September from a month earlier, a move that stands to squeeze domestic fuel makers at a time when Americans are already facing record high pump prices.

title: Dollar Gains as US Plan to Cut Off Iran Spurs Haven Demand
summary: The dollar rallied Monday as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US will cut Iran off from the global financial system, underscoring the greenback’s central role in trade and boosting its haven appeal.

title: Texas Stock Exchange Lures Two ETFs From NYSE
summary: Carlos Peña, head of ETF & funds management at Texas Capital, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." The Texas Stock Exchange notched its first primary listings as two small ETFs focused on the state’s economy announced plans to transfer to the upstart marketplace. The two ETFs are Texas Capital Texas Index ETF (ticker: TXS) and Texas Capital Texas Oil Index ETF (ticker: OILT).  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 24
summary: Oil fell after US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced what he called an “unprecedented” campaign to isolate Iran from the global economy, as the US seeks to pressure Tehran to loosen its grip on the Strait of Hormuz.

title: NHL Team Futures ETFs Filed, Draw Attention
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Athanasios Psarofagis joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." They discuss how Volatility Shares and Roundhill have filed for 32 ETFs based on each of the 32 teams in the NHL. Each fund will obtain exposure through CME futures tracking a team-specific FutureSports Performance Index. This index will be built from 55 measures -- including wins, losses, goals and other official stats.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US to Open More Ports to Mexican Cattle in Beef Supply Boost
summary: Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said the US will allow Mexican cattle shipments into two additional US ports over the next two months, in a move poised to boost beef supplies.

title: Trump Vows to Double Canadian Auto Tariffs, Escalating Fight
summary: Bloomberg's Melissa Shin said that negotiators in both Canada and the United States understand how important the auto sector is both countries as President Trump vowed to double existing tariffs on the Canadian auto industry. Shin said that the broader tariffs stand to impact an estimated 90,000 jobs and disproportionately small businesses that may not see as much government support.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Need 'All-Weather' Portfolio: Tuttle's Newton
summary: Frances Newton, CIO of Tuttle Capital Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." They discuss a report that the US Treasury could draw down some of its cash pile to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities in a bid to tackle rising borrowing costs. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: 'True ETF Innovation' Happening at Neos: Goldman's Lake
summary: Bryon Lake, chief transformation officer and global head of third party wealth at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and Troy Cates, co-founder of Neos Investments, join Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." They discuss how Neos is innovating in the ETF space.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Goldman M&A, NHL Futures | ETF IQ 8/24/2026
summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Byron Lake, Goldman Sachs Asset Management Global Co-Head of Third-Party Wealth, Troy Cates, NEOS Co-Founder, Frances Newton, Tuttle Capital Management CIO, Carlos Pena, Texas Capital Head of ETF and Funds Management, and Nick Samouilhan, Wellington Portfolio Manager. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Goldman, Neos Discuss $2.3 Billion Deal
summary: Bryon Lake, chief transformation officer and global head of third party wealth at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and Troy Cates, co-founder of Neos Investments, join Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." Goldman Sachs Asset Management will pay as much as $2.25 billion to buy Neos Investments, expanding its asset manager’s reach in the actively managed exchange-traded fund market.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Tells Iran’s Trade Partners to Cut Ties or Face Sanctions
summary: Vali Nasr, professor of international affairs & Middle East studies at Johns Hopkins University, said that he sees the declaration of new sanctions on Iran and its allies as a 'theatrical declaration' and less of a concrete move by the United States. Nasr said that the pressure on Iran's allies could potentially invite Chinese retaliation, which would widen the war 'out of the gulf and into the financial markets.'  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Protolabs Rides Manufacturing Momentum
summary: US manufacturing is getting a boost from growing demand across defense, aerospace and drones. Protolabs is tapping into that demand, using digital manufacturing to produce custom parts in as little as a day. CEO Suresh Krishna discusses the opportunity on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)
